stem.text: Compound L has the molecular formula $\text{C}_{10}\text{H}_{16}$.
A sample of L reacted with an excess of hot, concentrated, acidified potassium manganate(VII). Compound M is produced.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of compound M: a carbon chain with two ketone C=O groups and a terminal carboxylic acid group (COOH).
stem.label: M

stem.text: What could be the structure of compound L?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with a methyl group on one alkene carbon and an isopropenyl group, CH2=C(CH3)-, on the carbon opposite.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with a methyl group on one alkene carbon and a CH=CHCH3 (propenyl) group on the carbon opposite.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with a methyl group, a ring C=C on the far side, and an isopropenyl group on the carbon opposite the methyl.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with a methyl group, a ring C=C on the far side, and a CH=CHCH3 (propenyl) group on the carbon opposite the methyl.
